passages.text: Now Joshua was old and well along in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua had become old.
Joshua had lived many years.
The LORD spoke to Joshua.
The LORD said, “You are old.
You have lived many years.
Much land still remains.
Israel has not yet taken all the land.
There is still much land to possess.”
passages.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֙נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַיָּמִ֔ים וְהָאָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה־ מְאֹ֖ד לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: This is the land that remains: All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites, from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites; to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites; the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
passages.sermon:
This is the land that remains.
It includes all the territory of the Philistines.
It includes all the territory of the Geshurites.
It stretches from the Shihor, which is east of Egypt.
It goes north to the border of Ekron.
This area is considered Canaanite territory.
It includes the land ruled by five Philistine leaders.
These leaders are from Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
It also includes the land of the Avvites.
To the south, it includes all the land of the Canaanites.
It includes the area from Mearah, which belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek.
It goes as far as the border of the Amorites.
It includes the land of the Gebalites.
It includes all of Lebanon to the east.
This area stretches from Baal-gad, which is below Mount Hermon, to Lebo-hamath.
passages.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֖רֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כָּל־ גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְכָל־ הַגְּשׁוּרִֽי׃ מִֽן־ הַשִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְעַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הָעַזָּתִ֤י וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַגִּתִּ֔י וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְהָעַוִּֽים׃ מִתֵּימָ֞ן כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּמְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַצִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד־ אֲפֵ֑קָה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃ וְהָאָ֣רֶץ הַגִּבְלִ֗י וְכָל־ הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִבַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר־ חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃

passages.text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God said, “I will drive out all the people who live in the hill country.
These people live from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim.
All the Sidonians live there.
I Myself will remove them from before the Israelites.
You must divide this land by lot.
Give it as an inheritance to Israel.
Do this as I have commanded you.”
passages.original: כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠הָר מִֽן־ הַלְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד־ מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ כָּל־ צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אוֹרִישֵׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤הָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Joshua.
God commanded Joshua to divide the land.
Joshua must give the land as an inheritance.
Joshua must give the land to nine tribes of Israel.
Joshua must also give the land to half the tribe of Manasseh.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְתִשְׁעַ֣ת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַחֲצִ֖י הַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

passages.text: The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon, and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the Ammonites; also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all of Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah— the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim. Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them, but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites. So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses gave land to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
He gave them their inheritance east of the Jordan River.
He gave them the area from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Arnon Valley.
He gave them the city in the middle of the valley.
He gave them the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon.
He gave them all the cities of Sihon, king of the Amorites.
Sihon ruled in Heshbon.
Their land reached as far as the border of the Ammonites.
He gave them Gilead.
He gave them the territory of the Geshurites and the Maacathites.
He gave them all of Mount Hermon.
He gave them all of Bashan as far as Salecah.
He gave them the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Og had ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Og was a remnant of the Rephaim.
Moses struck down Og and took his land.
The Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites.
Geshur and Maacath still live among the Israelites to this day.
passages.original: עִמּ֗וֹ הָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְהַגָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃ מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד־ דִּיבֽוֹן׃ וְכֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד־ גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃ וְהַגִּלְעָ֞ד וּגְב֧וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְכֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־ סַלְכָֽה׃ כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־ מָלַ֥ךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃ וְלֹ֤א הוֹרִ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב גְּשׁ֤וּר וּמַֽעֲכָת֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The offerings made by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Levi was different from the other tribes of Israel.
Moses did not give the tribe of Levi any land as an inheritance.
The Levites did not receive territory like the other tribes.
The LORD, the God of Israel, gave the Levites a special inheritance.
The Levites received the offerings made by fire to the LORD.
These offerings were their inheritance.
God had promised this to the Levites.
God kept His promise to them.
passages.original: רַ֚ק לְשֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖ן נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Reuben: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, to the whole plateau beyond Medeba, to Heshbon and all its cities on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth— all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon until Moses killed him and the chiefs of Midian (Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba), the princes of Sihon who lived in the land.
passages.sermon:
Moses gave land to the tribe of Reuben.
He gave this land to their families.
Their territory began at Aroer.
Aroer was on the edge of the Arnon Valley.
Their land included the city in the middle of the valley.
Their land included the whole plateau near Medeba.
Their land included Heshbon.
Their land included all the cities on the plateau.
Their land included Dibon.
Their land included Bamoth-baal.
Their land included Beth-baal-meon.
Their land included Jahaz.
Their land included Kedemoth.
Their land included Mephaath.
Their land included Kiriathaim.
Their land included Sibmah.
Their land included Zereth-shahar, which was on the hill in the valley.
Their land included Beth-peor.
Their land included the slopes of Pisgah.
Their land included Beth-jeshimoth.
Their land included all the cities of the plateau.
Their land included all the kingdom of Sihon.
Sihon was king of the Amorites.
Sihon ruled in Heshbon.
Moses defeated Sihon.
Moses also defeated the chiefs of Midian.
The chiefs of Midian were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
These chiefs were princes of Sihon.
These princes lived in the land.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֜ם הַגְּב֗וּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ שְׂפַת־ נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־ הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל־ מֵידְבָֽא׃ חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְכָל־ עָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבוֹן֙ וּבָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּבֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃ וְיַ֥הְצָה וּקְדֵמֹ֖ת וּמֵפָֽעַת׃ וְקִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְשִׂבְמָ֔ה וְצֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּהַ֥ר הָעֵֽמֶק׃ וּבֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְאַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת׃ וְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֔ר וְכָֽל־ מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣וֹ׀ וְאֶת־ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־ אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־ רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־ צ֤וּר וְאֶת־ חוּר֙ וְאֶת־ רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites killed Balaam.
Balaam was the son of Beor.
Balaam was a diviner.
The Israelites killed Balaam with the sword.
The Israelites killed Balaam together with the others they struck down.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בִּלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ בְּע֖וֹר הַקּוֹסֵ֑ם הָרְג֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־ חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And the border of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites, including the cities and villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Reuben received land as their inheritance.
The border of the tribe of Reuben was the Jordan River.
The families of Reuben received this land.
Their inheritance included the cities.
Their inheritance also included the villages.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְב֑וּל זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad: The territory of Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah; the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir; and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth ).
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave land to the tribe of Gad.
He gave this land to the families of Gad.
Their territory included Jazer.
Their territory included all the cities of Gilead.
Their territory included half the land of the Ammonites.
This land reached as far as Aroer.
Aroer is near Rabbah.
Their territory also stretched from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh.
Their territory included Betonim.
Their territory went from Mahanaim to the border of Debir.
In the valley, their land included Beth-haram.
It included Beth-nimrah.
It included Succoth.
It included Zaphon.
They also received the rest of the kingdom of Sihon.
Sihon was king of Heshbon.
This land was on the east side of the Jordan River.
Their border reached to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ לְמַטֵּה־ גָ֔ד לִבְנֵי־ גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ הַגְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְכָל־ עָרֵ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וַחֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד־ עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה׃ וּמֵחֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד־ רָמַ֥ת הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּבְטֹנִ֑ים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד־ גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר׃ וּבָעֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּבֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְסֻכּ֣וֹת וְצָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְבֻ֑ל עַד־ קְצֵה֙ יָם־ כִּנֶּ֔רֶת עֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites, including the cities and villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Gad received land as their inheritance.
The families of Gad owned this land.
Their inheritance included cities.
Their inheritance also included villages.
passages.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan—all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities; half of Gilead; and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan. All this was for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh, that is, half of the descendants of Machir.
passages.sermon:
Moses gave land to half the tribe of Manasseh.
This half-tribe was part of the descendants of Manasseh.
Moses gave this land to their clans.
Their territory began at Mahanaim.
It included all of Bashan.
It included the whole kingdom of Og, king of Bashan.
It included all the towns of Jair in Bashan.
There were sixty cities in these towns.
It included half of Gilead.
It included Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Ashtaroth and Edrei were royal cities of Og in Bashan.
Moses gave all this land to the descendants of Machir, son of Manasseh.
He gave it to half the descendants of Machir, divided by their clans.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י לַחֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מִמַּחֲנַ֨יִם כָּֽל־ הַבָּשָׁ֜ן כָּֽל־ מַמְלְכ֣וּת׀ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן וְכָל־ חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר׃ וַחֲצִ֤י הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְאֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָׁ֑ן לִבְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי־ מָכִ֖יר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses gave land to the people of Israel.
He gave these portions on the plains of Moab.
This land was beyond the Jordan River.
It was east of Jericho.
passages.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָה׃ס

passages.text: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
passages.sermon:
Moses did not give any land to the tribe of Levi.
The tribe of Levi did not receive an inheritance of land.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD Himself is the inheritance of the tribe of Levi.
The LORD promised this to the tribe of Levi.
passages.original: וּלְשֵׁ֙בֶט֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹֽא־ נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָהֶֽם׃
